name: omp.auto-continue
description: Resends 继续 when a remote provider interruption ends a turn before the work is finished.

omp.name: Auto continue
omp.description: When a provider stream fails abnormally, sends 继续 so the interrupted turn resumes without touching the composer.

en.name: Auto continue
en.description: When a provider stream fails abnormally, sends 继续 so the interrupted turn resumes without touching the composer.
en.safetyNotes: Runs an engine extension that sends a 继续 prompt after a remote provider interruption. It reads no files, starts no process, and sends no network requests.

zh.name: 远端中断自动继续
zh.description: 远端模型流异常中断时，自动发送一条「继续」，让这一轮接着做完，不碰输入框里的内容。
zh.safetyNotes: 运行一个引擎扩展，在远端异常中断后发送「继续」。它不读文件、不启动进程、不发网络请求。
